title: Cache Epipe
objective: Make Sage.js CLI stdout tolerate consumers that close pipes early, with a subprocess regression for cache prune JSON and no cache policy changes

oracles: Node subprocess closes cache prune stdout after first chunk and observes clean exit

handoff.summary: Installed one idempotent stdout error handler for the source CLI and SEA entry point. EPIPE exits successfully for early-closing pipeline consumers, while every other output error is rethrown. Cache pruning policy and deletion behavior are unchanged. Focused tests cover a real early-close subprocess, deterministic EPIPE handling, and preservation of non-EPIPE failures.
risks: The full build reached production native-kernel generation but could not find the worktree-local M4RI static archive; TypeScript compilation, compiler rebuilding, and focused cache tests completed independently.
